articles.title: General Managers Meet Amid Labor Uncertainty
articles.summary: Randy Flores is set to enter high-stakes negotiations at the upcoming General Manager meetings amidst uncertainty over labor relations in baseball.
articles.content: Randy Flores, the newly appointed general manager of the Houston Astros, is set to enter high-stakes negotiations at the upcoming General Manager meetings amidst uncertainty over labor relations in baseball. A former relief pitcher for the St. Louis Cardinals, Flores brings a decade's worth of experience from his time under the guidance of John Mozeliak, who hired him as scouting director in 2015 and later promoted him to assistant general manager. Mozeliak, now interim general manager of the Los Angeles Angels, has offered Flores advice on navigating the complexities of the role, emphasizing the importance of building relationships with his new colleagues. Flores will need to prioritize several pressing tasks at the General Manager meetings, including hiring a major-league manager and assembling their coaching staff, all while juggling the looming threat of a potential December 1 lockout due to ongoing labor disputes in baseball. With the stakes high and time running out before the lockout deadline, Flores's ability to make swift and informed decisions will be crucial in setting the Astros' course for the upcoming season. The general managers' meetings in Las Vegas will bring together 30 teams, all navigating a challenging offseason amidst labor uncertainty. A lockout is anticipated to begin on December 1, when the collective bargaining agreement expires, effectively freezing major-league transactions until a new deal is reached. While the length and specifics of any potential lockout are unknown, its impact on team operations will be significant. The Astros are among those teams dealing with transition in their baseball operations, having recently named Randy Flores as their general manager. Flores' introduction on November 2 marked the beginning of his tenure, but key decisions remain to be made, including filling the managerial vacancy. The Houston Astros' offseason has officially begun under the guidance of General Manager Randy Flores, who faces a multitude of challenges in shaping the team's future. Flores inherits a roster that struggled to produce this season, particularly in the outfield, where the team ranked near the bottom of Major League Baseball. Additionally, there is a surplus of high-priced infield talent that may require some creative roster management. The impending General Manager meetings are expected to be more active than usual due to the looming possibility of a lockout, which could accelerate the offseason process. Some teams may opt to address their needs before a potential freeze, while others may prefer to wait until after. Free agents may also consider signing contracts before a lockout takes effect, given the uncertainty surrounding their future earning potential. The 2021 MLB lockout saw a flurry of major free-agent signings and trades in the days leading up to it. The new Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) is expected to bring significant changes, including possible alterations to free agency or salary arbitration, which will impact teams' ability to construct their rosters. The incoming general manager of the Houston Astros is Randy Flores, who will face significant challenges as he navigates the team's roster and payroll in the high-stakes offseason. Flores' thoughts on the current roster are not surprising given his background in baseball operations, but it remains to be seen how he will balance the needs of the team with any financial constraints that may arise from a new Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA). The Astros' goal of contending for the playoffs every year is clear, as owner Jim Crane has publicly stated that he expects the team to make the postseason annually. However, the exact financial parameters under which Flores will operate are still unclear. The team's current payroll situation is also a factor in Flores' decision-making process, with the Astros carrying the seventh-highest opening day payroll in 2026 and exceeding the first competitive balance tax threshold of $244 million for two consecutive years. The Houston Astros' roster decisions are being influenced by their ownership's cautious approach to contract extensions and free agent signings. This is evident in the team's history under owner Jim Crane, who has consistently avoided long-term deals or large payrolls. This strategy may impact the decision on whether to extend shortstop Jeremy Peña, who is entering his final season under team control. A potential trade for Peña could be a way to address the Astros' farm system, which is considered one of the thinnest in baseball. If this route is pursued, displaced third baseman Isaac Paredes could also be moved as part of an infield surplus. The team's offense and rotation are areas that need improvement, with the Astros leading the majors in home runs but struggling to score in other ways last season. Meanwhile, their rotation posted a high ERA, cycling through 19 different starters - a franchise record. The bullpen is another concern for the Astros, as they will likely lose several veteran relievers in free agency, including Bryan Abreu, Steven Okert and Enyel De Los Santos. This could create uncertainty about how to bridge games to closer Josh Hader, who commands a $95 million contract. Randy Flores is set to attend his first general managers' meetings as a head of baseball operations this week in Las Vegas. He will be joining other top executives at the Aria Resort to discuss various aspects of the game, marking an important milestone in his career. As he prepares for this high-stakes offseason, Flores faces uncertainty surrounding labor negotiations and their potential impact on the sport. His background and experience make him well-suited for the role, with a unique blend of playing and executive experience that has been praised by those who know him. articles.title: Wildlife Researchers Document Rare Snow-Adapted Wild Cat in New Mexico
articles.summary: A team led by Ph.D. student William Grooms has documented a rare snow-adapted wild cat known as a Canada lynx in Carson National Forest.
articles.content: Wildlife researchers in northern New Mexico have made an exciting discovery after months of camera trap monitoring. A team led by Ph.D. student William Grooms has been documenting wildlife across Carson National Forest using motion-sensing cameras as part of a two-year study on forest structure and biodiversity. Grooms spent the summer deploying dozens of these cameras to capture images of the region's diverse wildlife, including animals like squirrels, rabbits, bears, and foxes that are known to inhabit the San Juan Mountains. The cameras have been collecting valuable data for months now, but it was only recently that Grooms began reviewing his initial batch of photos. While scanning through the images, Grooms stumbled upon something remarkable, a rare snow-adapted wild cat known as a Canada lynx. This sighting is significant because the species had not been documented in New Mexico for over a quarter-century. The identification of the Canada lynx was confirmed by experts after Grooms sent them the photos. He expressed his excitement about this discovery, stating that it's just one of the many interesting findings emerging from their research so far. The team is eager to continue analyzing the camera trap data and uncover more secrets about the region's wildlife. As part of a larger study on forest structure and biodiversity in the Southern Rocky Mountains, Grooms' team aims to provide valuable insights into how forests support a wide range of plant and animal species. The discovery of a rare wild cat in northern New Mexico has significant implications for conservation efforts in the region. Canada lynx are known to inhabit dense boreal and subalpine forests and woodlands across most of Canada and Alaska, where they can be distinguished from bobcats by their grayish or yellowish-brown coat and wide fur-lined paws. Despite reintroduction efforts in the San Juan Mountains between 1999 and 2006, Canada lynx populations have remained low throughout the contiguous United States. This species is still considered threatened under the Endangered Species Act, highlighting the need for effective conservation strategies. The presence of a Canada lynx in northern New Mexico has sparked excitement among wildlife enthusiasts and experts alike. According to Dr. Jennifer Frey, a professor of mammalogy at NMSU, this discovery may lead to additional considerations for managing this species and its habitat by state and federal governments. The specific environment required by both the Canada lynx and snowshoe hares is crucial for their survival. These animals rely on deep snow and spruce-fir forest environments, where they can hunt for their primary prey under downed trees, logs, and dense vegetation known as the forest understory. The unique habitats of the Canada lynx and snowshoe hare present a challenge for forest managers in northern New Mexico. These forests are often targeted for hazardous fuel removals due to their propensity to contribute to large fires when they catch on fire. However, these same conditions are crucial for the survival of these rare wild cats and hares. As warmer climates lead to drier conditions that fuel devastating wildfires, finding solutions becomes increasingly important. Grooms' research project aims to build resilience in the Southern Rocky Mountains by maintaining wildlife diversity. Leveraging previous work from 2022, he is studying the preferred forest structure of 10 species in the region, including trees and vegetation arrangement. Using motion-activated cameras, Grooms photographed wildlife at 120 sites across Carson National Forest this summer, with a second round of documentation planned for next summer to complete his project. The conservation project aims to ensure the long-term survival of Canada lynx and other species in New Mexico and the Southern Rocky Mountains by developing effective forest management strategies. Motion-activated cameras have been used to monitor wildlife at 120 sites across Carson National Forest this summer, with a second round of documentation planned for next summer to complete the project. articles.title: Routers Can Overheat and Cause Connectivity Issues
articles.summary: Excessive heat generation in Wi-Fi routers can lead to connectivity problems and damage internal components.
articles.content: A common issue affecting many households is their Wi-Fi routers overheating, which can lead to connectivity problems and even damage the device itself. Home routers generate heat as a normal part of operation, but excessive heat can be a cause for concern. These devices contain various electronic components, such as processors, memory, wireless radios, and power management modules, all of which contribute to the production of heat. Modern routers often use system on a chip (SoC) architecture, where core networking components are integrated onto a single semiconductor chip. When operating normally, modern routers transmit vast amounts of data per second, placing increased demands on their CPUs and contributing to additional heat generation. If an overheated router exceeds its recommended operating temperature threshold, users may experience connectivity issues or device shutdowns. Continuing to use such a router can lead to damage of internal components, rendering the device unusable. To keep routers from overheating, proper ventilation is often the first step in addressing the issue. However, this alone may not be enough, and further troubleshooting steps are necessary to identify the root cause of the problem. When a router overheats, it can be a sign that something is amiss. However, an overheating router's symptoms don't always scream for attention. One way to determine if your router is overheating is to touch it - if it feels uncomfortably hot, it's likely experiencing temperature issues. An overheating router may also exhibit erratic behavior, including frequent connection drops and slow network speeds. This can be confusing, as these problems could have other causes, but they are often linked to a device struggling with heat management. In some cases, the CPU may even throttle down performance to prevent damage from excessive temperatures. The Wi-Fi bands on an overheating router may also malfunction, causing them to switch and lose effectiveness. This can be frustrating for users who rely on their devices for internet access. Temporarily resolving the issue by letting the device cool down before turning it back on is not a long-term solution, as the problem will recur once the device heats up again. Poor ventilation is just one of several factors that could cause an overheating router. Other potential causes include faulty power adapters and failing routers themselves. To identify the root cause, troubleshooting steps must be taken to determine what's driving the temperature issues. Moving a router to a well-ventilated area can help alleviate overheating problems caused by poor ventilation. It's also essential to avoid placing devices in closed spaces or near objects that could restrict airflow. Additionally, keeping routers away from windows and devices like computers and consoles that emit heat under load can help maintain optimal operating temperatures. Dust buildup can hinder airflow through router vents, causing temperatures to rise. Regularly cleaning these vents can help maintain optimal operating conditions. Moreover, ensuring your router's firmware is up-to-date is crucial in addressing performance and stability issues. If temperature concerns persist after cleaning the vents and updating the firmware, it's possible that the power adapter might be at fault. Using a faulty or under-rated adapter can lead to excessive heat dissipation and potentially damage components. Replacing the power adapter with one suitable for your router should alleviate these issues. The power adapter is not always the culprit, however, and in some cases, the problem may reside within the router itself. If cleaning, updating firmware, and replacing the power adapter fail to stabilize temperatures, it's likely that the router has reached the end of its lifespan and requires replacement. In such instances, upgrading to a new router with improved cooling mechanisms can provide a safe and reliable solution, ensuring optimal performance and minimizing the risk of overheating. articles.title: Bram Stoker's Working Notes Reveal Early Title and Character Names
articles.summary: Research has shown that Bram Stoker's novel was tentatively titled "The Un-Dead" before being published as "Dracula".
articles.content: London bookstores received their first copies of a yellow-covered novel by Bram Stoker in May 1897, but the book's title was not always "Dracula. In fact, for most of the seven years it took to write, the book had been known by a different name. The alternative title that nearly made it into print is well-documented. Research has shown that at one point during its development, the novel was tentatively titled The Un-Dead, and this label came perilously close to being the one on the front cover. But even before the book's title was settled, the vampire protagonist had a name of his own. Bram Stoker's working notes, now housed in Philadelphia at the Rosenbach collection, originally referred to the villain as Count Wampyr. Stoker's research into Eastern European history and geography also played a role in shaping the novel's characters and setting. In 1890, he borrowed William Wilkinson's survey of Wallachia and Moldavia from his local library in Whitby, where he copied out a footnote about the word Dracula. Stoker's working notes reveal that the vampire character was initially referred to as Count Wampyr. This name was crossed out in favor of a new one at some point during his writing process, which is believed to have been inspired by a footnote about the word Dracula from William Wilkinson's survey of Wallachia and Moldavia. The transformation of Stoker's notes highlights how he was researching various names for the vampire before settling on one. The change in name suggests that Stoker was actively exploring different options, reflecting his meticulous approach to crafting the character. A significant portion of Stoker's handwritten working copy has survived, providing valuable insights into his writing process. This typescript, which spans 529 pages, is marked up with various revisions and corrections, offering a glimpse into the author's creative evolution. The typescript, which surfaced in the United States around 1980, was later sold to a collector who put it up for auction at Christie's in New York in April 2002. The item failed to meet its reserve price of £1 million, but its presence underscores the enduring value and fascination with Stoker's original manuscript. The typescript remains an important artifact for scholars studying Stoker's writing process, offering a tangible connection to the author's creative journey. Its existence serves as a testament to the meticulous research and revisions that went into crafting one of literature's most iconic characters. A publishing contract between Bram Stoker and Archibald Constable and Company reveals an interesting inconsistency regarding the title of his novel. The document, drafted by Stoker himself, bears a date of May 20, 1897, with some pages even bearing his initials as late as May 25. Despite this, the contract still refers to the work in progress as The Un-Dead. Meanwhile, Constable's advertising efforts were already underway under the title Dracula. Research by scholar John Edgar Browning uncovered newspaper ads that appeared in The Athenaeum on May 8 and the Booksellers' Review on May 13. These ads predated Stoker's contract by at least 12 days. The discrepancy between the two titles is striking, especially considering that the publishing contract didn't mention Dracula at all. Instead, it was for a first edition of 3,000 copies, priced at six shillings apiece. This suggests that the title change had already been made by the time Stoker signed the agreement. It's worth noting that the title The Un-Dead is not entirely unfamiliar to readers of Stoker's work. The term has since become synonymous with vampire lore, and it's possible that the author was experimenting with different titles before settling on one. Despite the confusion surrounding the title, Stoker's publishing contract remains an important piece of literary history. It provides a glimpse into the behind-the-scenes negotiations between authors and publishers during this period. As researchers continue to uncover more details about the creation of Dracula, it becomes increasingly clear that Stoker's novel was the result of a collaborative effort involving multiple individuals and organizations. The reading at the Lyceum Theatre on May 18 was a hastily organized event, staged just eight days before Bram Stoker's novel was set to be released. The purpose of this performance was to protect the dramatic rights to the story, and it was billed as Dracula: or The Un-Dead. However, the audience for this reading was remarkably small. The reasons behind the sparse attendance at this event are unclear, but it is likely that the novelty of Stoker's work had yet to gain traction with the public. Despite its potential, the novel's dramatic adaptation failed to draw in crowds, leaving some to wonder if the effort was worthwhile. A 2012 study delved into the mystery surrounding the title Dracula: or The Un-Dead, attempting to piece together the sequence of events that led to its adoption. By examining contracts, typescripts, and advertisements from the time, researchers sought to determine when and by whom the title changed. Unfortunately, the study's findings were inconclusive, leaving unanswered questions about who was responsible for modifying the title. Some accounts suggest an editor may have been involved in the change, but there is no concrete evidence to support this claim. The uncertainty surrounding the title's evolution adds another layer of complexity to the story behind Bram Stoker's novel. As researchers continue their investigation into the creation and development of Dracula, they are uncovering a rich tapestry of influences and collaborations that shaped the final product. The original title for Bram Stoker's iconic novel Dracula" was actually "Un-Dead, but this name did not stick. In fact, the word Un-Dead appears more than 30 times in the final version of the book. This abandoned title has been revisited by some, including Dacre Stoker and Dracula historian Ian Holt, who published a sequel called Dracula: The Un-Dead" in 2009. articles.title: Fitbits can be restarted without causing harm
articles.summary: Restarting a Fitbit watch can resolve various problems such as issues with syncing, screen responsiveness, and tracking stats.
articles.content: Restarting your Fitbit watch is a common solution when encountering issues with the device. However, frequent restarting may not be necessary for most users. When your Fitbit starts acting up, you might consider turning it off and back on again. This trick can be effective in resolving various problems, similar to restarting your laptop or router when they experience technical difficulties. Some common issues that a restart can fix include the device failing to sync with the app, the screen being unresponsive, or delays in tracking stats. Additionally, if swipes or taps are not registering properly, a reboot might be all it takes to get everything working smoothly again. A key point to note is that there's no limit to how often you can restart your Fitbit without causing harm to the device. This means you don't have to worry about overusing this feature. However, regular restarting is only necessary when there's a valid reason to do so. If your Fitbit is functioning normally and you're not experiencing any issues, there's no need to restart it unnecessarily. Sometimes, devices like Fitbits require a reboot to get back on track. This can happen when they've experienced technical difficulties or lost connection. Restarting is an essential process that helps troubleshoot issues without losing any stored data. When it comes to restarting your Fitbit, it's crucial to distinguish between restart and reset. A reset will erase all of your device's data, whereas a restart simply shuts down the device temporarily before allowing it to reboot on its own. Reset should only be used in extreme cases, such as when you're giving or selling the device. Some models of Fitbits have small holes for sensors like microphones and altimeters. It's essential not to insert any objects into these openings, as this can cause damage to your device. This is a specific warning from Google, which emphasizes the importance of handling your Fitbit with care. Common issues that may be resolved by restarting your Fitbit include problems syncing with the Google Health app, not registering steps and sleep data, and failing to display notifications and reminders. Even if your device becomes completely unresponsive or enters a continuous reboot loop, a simple restart can often resolve the issue. If you find yourself frequently experiencing these types of issues, it may be worth investigating further to determine if there's an underlying problem with your Fitbit. In some cases, a device may simply have reached its end-of-life and require replacement. To restart your Fitbit watch, the process varies depending on the model you have. For newer models such as the Fitbit Versa 4 and Sense 2, go to Settings > About > Shutdown > Yes. For other models like the Charge 5 and 6, Inspire 3, and some older devices, the steps are slightly different. You'll need to navigate to Settings > Restart Device > Restart or, for certain models, Settings > About > Reboot Device. Some Fitbit users may be unsure about how to restart their device if it's not responding properly. For these situations, there is a separate process that can help. With screenless devices like the Fitbit Air, you'll need to connect it to its charging cable and press and hold the back button for about 10 seconds until the side light flashes white. Once this process is complete, your device should restart successfully. However, if you're still unsure or have a more complex issue with your device, there are additional steps that can be taken. For example, if your Charge 5 or Charge 6 isn't responding, try connecting it to its charging cable and pressing the button on the flat end three times in rapid succession. In some cases, this may cause the Fitbit logo to appear on screen after a short delay. If you're using an Inspire 3 model that's not functioning properly, plug it into its charger and press and hold both buttons for 10 seconds before releasing them and waiting for the device to vibrate and show the Fitbit logo. This process can help resolve issues with non-responsive devices and get your Fitbit watch up and running again. However, if you're experiencing persistent problems or are unsure about how to restart your device, it's always a good idea to consult the manufacturer's support page for more information. Restarting your Fitbit device can resolve various issues that may have arisen. This process typically involves shutting down and restarting the watch to clear out any temporary glitches or bugs that could be affecting its performance. articles.title: Apple's Freeform App Offers Infinite Canvas for Creativity and Collaboration
articles.summary: The app allows users to create an infinite canvas where they can spread out ideas, photos, sketches, links, and PDFs in any way they choose.
articles.content: A free digital whiteboard app has been hiding in plain sight on iPhones since last year, waiting to be discovered by those seeking a more organized approach to creativity and collaboration. Apple's Freeform app offers an infinite canvas where users can spread out ideas, photos, sketches, links, and PDFs in any way they choose. The app allows for seamless reorganization without the need to rewrite everything, making it ideal for visual plans that are easier to show than explain. Others can also participate in the creative process by joining a Freeform board. This feature is particularly useful for brainstorming sessions or when working on projects with colleagues or team members. While Freeform isn't a miracle app capable of organizing one's entire life, it has the potential to make messy projects less daunting and more manageable. The best part? It comes at no additional cost, making it an attractive option for those seeking a free solution to their organizational needs. When opening a new Freeform board, users are presented with a blank canvas that expands as they add content. This flexible space can be used in conjunction with finger-drawn scribbles or the addition of photos and sticky notes, allowing items to be rearranged until a clear picture emerges. Freeform also enables users to create connections between related items by drawing arrows, providing an intuitive way to visualize relationships between different components. Furthermore, the app allows for zooming in and out to focus on specific details or take a step back to see the bigger picture. The use of an Apple Pencil is optional, with iPhone Duo owners running iOS 27.2 or later able to utilize the device to sketch directly within Freeform. Freeform's capabilities extend beyond text and images, allowing users to add videos, PDFs, website links, and text boxes to their boards. This versatility makes it an ideal tool for brainstorming sessions or project planning. For instance, you can use Freeform as a storyboard by laying out reference images and notes for each shot, then rearranging the scenes as your ideas evolve. Alternatively, you can sketch out a DIY project on the canvas, keeping drawings and measurements readily available. The app's flexibility also means that users don't need to clutter their boards with unnecessary features. For example, a grocery list might not require an infinite whiteboard, but Freeform still offers the space for it if needed. Since its introduction in iOS 16.2, Freeform has gained some notable features, including Dark Mode and folders, which were added in iOS 27. The app's capabilities have been expanded further with the inclusion of Image Playground on compatible iPhones. Image Playground allows users to create illustrations for their boards, but Freeform itself doesn't require Apple Intelligence. This means that anyone can use the app without needing a specific level of device capability. Freeform also offers real-time collaboration features, allowing multiple users to contribute to a board and see each other's changes in real time. This makes it easy for groups to plan vacations or work on projects together, without having to sift through message threads. The expanding canvas of the iPhone's built-in app for creativity, Freeform, has its limitations. For instance, navigating larger boards on a smaller iPhone screen can be cumbersome, but this might not be an issue for future models. Board creation and sharing remain free within the app, regardless of whether users opt for Apple's Creator Studio subscription or not. The latter offers premium assets and advanced AI image-generation tools for compatible iPhones, although these features are not required for basic brainstorming tasks. articles.title: Bees and Hoverflies Contribute Significantly to Ecosystem Services
articles.summary: Insects play vital roles in sustaining the natural world by providing numerous benefits including pollination and decomposition.
articles.content: At least 14 million insect species are known to exist on Earth, playing vital roles in sustaining the natural world. Insects provide numerous benefits, often referred to as "ecosystem services," including pollination and decomposition. Pollinators such as bees and hoverflies contribute significantly to the reproduction of wildflowers and agricultural crops. Dung beetles, on the other hand, break down manure and other waste materials, recycling nutrients back into the ecosystem. Insects play a crucial role in creating and maintaining habitats for other species, often building massive structures that provide shelter and protection. Termite nests, for instance, serve as ideal breeding grounds for reptiles, who can lay their eggs in the climate-controlled environment within these mounds. Parrots also find termite nests suitable for nesting purposes. In dry regions, some frogs take advantage of ant nests by living inside them to escape harsh conditions and evade detection. The soil surrounding termite mounds creates an ideal environment for other species to build their burrows. The nutrient-rich soil supports the growth of plants, which in turn provides a grazing habitat for herbivores such as gazelles. Ant nests also concentrate nutrients that enhance plant growth, thereby supporting the local ecosystem. Insects serve as protectors and bodyguards for vertebrates, providing defense against predators. This may seem counterintuitive, but certain species rely on insects to ward off threats. For example, horned lizards have developed a unique defense mechanism by turning chemicals from ants into a toxic substance that repels big cats. Vertebrates also obtain toxicity from the chemical compounds found in insects they eat. Poisonous frogs, birds, and snakes store toxins from ants and beetles as part of their defensive strategy, using these poisonous substances to deter predators. Some birds have evolved a clever strategy to deter predators from their nests by deliberately choosing locations near wasp colonies. The presence of these aggressive insects serves as a warning sign, making potential threats think twice before approaching the nest. In addition to this defensive tactic, some vertebrates have developed an uncanny ability to mimic the appearance and movement of insects. For instance, young songbirds in the Amazon rainforest will move their heads to resemble fuzzy caterpillars when predators are nearby, effectively disguising themselves as harmless food sources. Insects also play a vital role in maintaining ecosystem health by removing waste from environments. By decomposing carcasses and dung, they help prevent disease transmission among wild vertebrates. For example, certain species of insects tunnel through and bury dung, making it an unfavorable habitat for parasites to thrive. Some mosquito species are notorious for transmitting diseases such as malaria, but other insects have a crucial role in controlling their populations. Dragonflies, in particular, are fierce aquatic predators that feed on mosquito larvae during their larval stage. In a surprising twist, the ability of certain insects to spread diseases has also led to conservation success stories. In Australia, scientists used mosquitoes to transmit a virus that helped control invasive European rabbit populations, ultimately leading to an increase in native marsupial populations such as bilbies and other threatened species. Research has uncovered numerous medicinal compounds within insects, with many more likely waiting to be discovered. One fascinating example is observed in chimpanzees, who have been known to press flying insects into wounds, suggesting a potential healing effect. Insects are also a vital source of sustenance for countless species. They dominate the biomass and numbers in nearly every terrestrial and freshwater ecosystem on Earth, with their collective weight far exceeding that of all wild vertebrates combined. The consumption of insects is not limited to birds and bats; even grizzly bears have been known to eat moths as part of their winter bulk-up regimen. This highlights the crucial role insects play in supporting the food supply for various animal species. In addition to being a direct source of nutrition, insects also have an indirect impact on the food chain. Many plants rely on insects as pollinators, and when these relationships are disrupted, it can have far-reaching consequences. For instance, small wasps are the sole pollinators of fig trees, which provide fruit for over 1,200 vertebrate species. This intricate web of relationships between insects, plants, and animals underscores the importance of maintaining balanced ecosystems. Changes in insect populations can also lead to significant alterations within ecosystems. The introduction of invasive ants has been known to disrupt native ant-plant relationships, ultimately affecting the behavior of larger herbivores like elephants, which may alter their prey patterns in response. Sloths have a unique relationship with moths that live in their fur, which has puzzled scientists for some time. It's been observed that sloths make a slow and perilous journey to the ground once a week, defecating without any apparent reason. Research has now revealed that these moths play a crucial role in the sloth's ecosystem. The moths provide essential nutrients to algae that grow in the sloth's fur, which the sloth then consumes as part of its diet. This symbiotic relationship also gives sloths their characteristic green hue, helping them blend into their forest surroundings. The sloth's regular excursions to the ground serve a vital purpose beyond just eliminating waste. The moths reproduce within the sloth's dung, allowing them to complete their life cycle. This intricate connection between species highlights the complex interdependencies that exist in ecosystems. Insects perform a multitude of functions and services for both humans and other animals, including large vertebrates like sloths and songbirds. As insect populations decline, these relationships are disrupted, potentially destabilizing entire ecosystems. The preservation of insects is essential to maintaining biodiversity, as they support the well-being of numerous species that rely on them. By conserving insects, people not only protect the insects themselves but also safeguard the many species that depend on them for survival and prosperity. Insects play a crucial role in maintaining ecosystem balance by contributing to nutrient cycling, pollination, and seed dispersal. This vital support has a ripple effect on vertebrate populations, influencing their habitat quality, availability of food sources, and overall health. Pollinators like bees and butterflies are essential for the reproduction of many plant species, while seed dispersers like ants and beetles help spread seeds to new areas, promoting vegetation growth and diversity. Insects also contribute to nutrient cycling by breaking down organic matter and recycling nutrients back into the environment. articles.title: Hamptons Parents Struggle to Teach Children About Money
articles.summary: Living in the Hamptons can be challenging for parents trying to teach children valuable life lessons about money and happiness.
articles.content: Living in the Hamptons year-round has its perks, but it also comes with a unique set of challenges for parents like me who want to teach our children valuable life lessons about money and happiness. My kids are surrounded by opulence every day - beautiful homes, luxurious boats in the harbor, expensive cars driving by, and designer shops lining the streets. However, our family's financial situation is far from wealthy. As a parent, I'm acutely aware of the importance of teaching them that true happiness doesn't come from material possessions or keeping up with what others have. The problem is, every day presents opportunities for comparison - and expensive prices can make it difficult to drive home this lesson. A simple smoothie can cost upwards of $30 in some establishments, including my favorite spot in Sag Harbor. Even a casual outing for ice cream quickly adds up: two frozen yogurt sundaes with toppings can set us back around $28. These kinds of expenses are particularly concerning because they create unrealistic expectations about what's normal or affordable. I want my children to understand that money is finite and make conscious choices about how it's spent, rather than feeling entitled to indulge in expensive treats every time we step out the door. Living in a community like the Hamptons can be a double-edged sword for parents trying to raise grounded children. On one hand, there are plenty of opportunities to indulge in luxury and excess, but on the other hand, this can create unrealistic expectations about what is normal. To find a balance, we often visit local stores that offer a mix of high-end and nostalgic items, such as Kites of the Harbor and The Wharf Shop. Browsing these places can be a fun way for kids to experience the community without feeling overwhelmed by expensive prices. It's essential to have open conversations with our children about money and finances in a way they can understand. We discuss saving and spending regularly, but also make it clear that not everything is affordable. When my kids spend their own money, they develop a keen sense of value and are more likely to think critically about whether something is worth the cost. They weigh the pros and cons of each purchase, considering what else they might have to give up in order to afford it. In addition to teaching our children how to manage money, we also make a conscious effort to show them that some of the best experiences don't have to cost anything at all. We take advantage of free activities like library classes and museum passes, and spend time enjoying nature and community events. The diverse population of the Hamptons is an important aspect of life here, and my children are exposed to people from various financial backgrounds. As a result, they see that wealth doesn't always manifest in luxury brands or expensive goods; sometimes it's about the values and skills that people possess. This realization is reinforced when we engage with activities that don't involve spending money, such as visiting libraries and museums using free passes. These experiences help my children appreciate the community aspect of living in the Hamptons. To foster resourcefulness, I encourage my kids to create things from scratch, like homemade scrubs, and find ways to reuse materials for new projects. This approach not only teaches them practical skills but also shows that making something well can be both creative and useful. For instance, when we cook with private chefs, they learn that preparing a meal is an art form that requires skill and attention to detail. I also emphasize the importance of being organized and self-sufficient at home by teaching my children to keep track of their belongings and take care of them properly. As a parent, I've been teaching my children valuable life lessons that will serve them well beyond their childhood years. By engaging them in activities like ice-skating and tennis, not only are they developing essential physical skills but also learning the importance of dedication and hard work. These hobbies have not only become an enjoyable way to spend time together as a family but also provide opportunities for my children to develop marketable skills that can potentially lead to future careers. For instance, someone with expertise in tennis may consider working at a tennis shop or even stringing racquets, while a skilled ice-skater could become an instructor or attendants at skating rinks. It's essential for them to understand that their abilities and reliability are valuable assets that can open doors to various opportunities. I want my children to be practical, resourceful, and equipped with skills that set them apart from others. By instilling these qualities in them, I hope they will develop a strong sense of self-reliance and appreciate the value of hard work. Ultimately, as their parent, it's my responsibility to equip them with the tools necessary to navigate life's challenges and make informed decisions about their future. By doing so, I'm confident that they'll be able to measure their lives by what they can create, contribute, and achieve, rather than just comparing themselves to others who may have more privileges or advantages. articles.title: Israeli President Isaac Herzog Selects Gadi Eisenkot to Form New Government
articles.summary: Isaac Herzog has selected Gadi Eisenkot to attempt to form a new government following last month's parliamentary elections. The move comes after the polls left neither Eisenkot nor Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu with a clear majority.
articles.content: Israeli President Isaac Herzog has selected former military chief Gadi Eisenkot to attempt to form a new government following last month's parliamentary elections. The move comes after the polls left neither Eisenkot nor Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu with a clear majority. Eisenkot is Netanyahu's strongest rival, and his selection by Herzog marks a significant development in the ongoing political stalemate. The elections saw Netanyahu's religious-nationalist coalition lose its majority, but it remains the largest bloc in parliament. The anti-Netanyahu bloc led by Eisenkot has refused to collaborate with Arab parties that could potentially hand them a majority. However, despite this, Arab leaders have nominated Eisenkot for the role of forming a new government after marathon talks with Herzog. Eisenkot's selection will now see him attempting to build a coalition and secure a majority in parliament, presenting a challenge to Netanyahu's bid to remain in power as Israel's longest-serving leader. The Israeli president has entrusted Gadi Eisenkot with the task of forming a government, following weeks of intense negotiations after the recent elections. As per presidential protocol, Eisenkot will now attempt to assemble a coalition in parliament, which is expected to be a complex and challenging process. With a 28-day deadline to form a government, Eisenkot has three potential pathways to power: attempting to create a minority government with support from Arab parties, forming an alliance with ultra-Orthodox groups he had previously shunned, or forging a unity government with incumbent Prime Minister Netanyahu. However, analysts suggest that all these options are unlikely to materialize. Eisenkot's selection comes as a result of the failure of Netanyahu's wider religious-nationalist coalition to secure a majority in parliament, despite winning the most seats for any single party. With only 53 seats out of a total 120, Netanyahu's chances of remaining in power appear slim. The Likud party secured 27 seats, but it was not enough to guarantee a continuation of Netanyahu's tenure. The process of forming a government is expected to be protracted, with the possibility of extensions and further negotiations. If Eisenkot fails to assemble a coalition, another candidate will be nominated to attempt to form a government, with the option of holding new elections if all else fails. Eisenkot's Yashar party secured 21 seats, emerging as the second-largest party in the election. This significant showing enabled Eisenkot to form a coalition government, comprising four centre-left to right-wing Jewish-led parties that collectively won 48 seats. However, this tally fell short of an outright majority, leaving Eisenkot with the daunting task of assembling a stable coalition. His background as a military commander, who oversaw operations in Lebanon, has been highlighted by his campaign team as a key asset in navigating Israel's complex security landscape. Eisenkot comes from a unique cultural heritage, being the son of Moroccan immigrants, and would be the first prime minister from Israel's Mizrahi community. This demographic shift is significant, given that Jews tracing their roots to the Middle East and North Africa have historically been underrepresented in Israeli politics. The personal costs of Eisenkot's involvement in national service are also well-documented, with his family having suffered the loss of a son and two nephews during combat in Gaza since 2023. Eisenkot's views on Israel's military doctrine are at odds with his new role as prime minister-designate. He has expressed opposition to a policy known as "Dahiya Doctrine", named after a Beirut suburb devastated by war, which authorizes the use of disproportionate force against civilian infrastructure. Critics have accused Israel of committing war crimes in Gaza, where over 74,000 Palestinians have lost their lives since the assault began. However, Israel disputes these claims and maintains that its actions are justified under military necessity. articles.title: SpaceXAI makes Grok chatbot available as free add-on in Google Workspace
articles.summary: Users can access Grok's features directly within Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides through the Extensions menu.
articles.content: SpaceXAI has made its chatbot, Grok, available as a free add-on in Google Workspace, allowing users to access its features directly within Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides. The installation process is straightforward - simply head to the Google Workspace Marketplace, click on the "Add-ons tab, search for Grok, and select it from the results. Once installed, open any of the three supported apps and navigate to the Extensions menu to access Grok's functionality. From there, you can activate the add-on and start using its features. Grok's capabilities are diverse and powerful, offering a range of tools that can enhance productivity within Google Workspace. For instance, it can be used to fact-check claims and generate images, in addition to providing real-time feedback on spreadsheets by highlighting relevant cells. It also has the ability to convert outlines into slide decks and transform rough notes into formatted documents. The availability of Grok as a free add-on is likely to be of interest to Google Workspace users, but it's worth noting that there are some factors to consider before integrating it into your workflow. To install Grok in Google Workspace, navigate to the Google Workspace Marketplace where it is listed as a free add-on. Click on the Install button and select the Google account you wish to use, then proceed by clicking Continue. Alternatively, if you're already working on a file within Docs, Sheets or Slides, you can install Grok directly from the Extensions menu. Once you've initiated the installation process, you'll be prompted to grant permissions for Grok to access your Google Workspace files. Specifically, it will request see, edit, create and delete permissions for all Google Docs files and every Slides presentation in your account. However, its access is more limited when it comes to Sheets, covering only those spreadsheets where the add-on has been installed. After installation, you can access Grok's features by opening any doc, spreadsheet or presentation within Workspace and navigating to the Extensions menu. From there, select Grok" and click on "Open Grok" to bring up a side panel with its functionality. You'll then be prompted to sign in and authenticate before Grok becomes fully accessible. Once authenticated, Grok's features will be available across all three Workspace apps - Docs, Sheets, and Slides. This allows you to seamlessly integrate its capabilities into your workflow without having to switch between different tools or interfaces. Grok can seamlessly integrate into Google Docs, allowing it to write directly onto the page while performing tasks typical of language models, such as formatting text and creating lists from rough notes. However, when put to the test, Grok's output was less than polished in some cases, with a draft generated from installation instructions exhibiting noticeable AI-generated content. This is not an isolated incident, as other instances of Grok's writing have shown similar characteristics. One notable feature of Grok is its ability to track changes made within Google Docs, making it easy to review and revert back to previous versions if needed. Additionally, with Grok's connectors activated, the tool can access context from recent emails or files stored in Google Drive, though this requires granting it permission to do so. In Slides, Grok demonstrates its capabilities by building presentation decks from outlines, creating new slides that match existing themes and even researching topics from online sources. This includes pulling information from X, although some may question the reliability of such a source. To test its limits, I asked Grok to build a six-slide deck focused on its own track record for accuracy and bias since 2025, complete with cited sources on each slide and a final rating of its reliability as a source. Grok's capabilities extend beyond data analysis in Sheets. It can read selected ranges, provide answers with citations, and even insert charts into the document. Additionally, Grok can rerun scenarios when assumptions are changed, allowing users to undo changes as they would with any ordinary edit. The integration of Gemini, Google's chatbot, is also worth noting. By default, it opens from an icon at the top-right corner of various Workspace apps, including Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drive, and Chat. However, access to Gemini comes at a cost, as it requires eligible Workspace plans for work accounts or specific subscriptions for personal accounts. Google's decision to fold Gemini into its Business and Enterprise plans in January 2025 eliminated the need for a separate add-on that had previously increased costs by $32 per user per month. Since then, access to Gemini has become more restricted, available only through paid subscriptions. This shift also applies to Google's agent, which is now paywalled. Grok stands out from Gemini in several key areas. Firstly, it can integrate with data from X, but this feature may be seen as a double-edged sword. Additionally, Grok has limitations in terms of app access, being restricted to Docs, Sheets, and Slides compared to Gemini's wider reach across Workspace. However, users can work around these restrictions by granting Grok access to Gmail and Drive files via connectors. This allows for some flexibility in using Grok despite its limited scope. articles.title: Study Finds Doctoral Students Need Rhetorical Agility to Write Across Different Genres
articles.summary: Researchers have found that mastering one type of text does not automatically translate to being able to write for another, posing a challenge for academics who need to communicate complex ideas.
articles.content: A new study from Chalmers University of Technology has shed light on how doctoral students can adapt their writing to reach different audiences. Researchers have found that mastering one type of text does not automatically translate to being able to write for another. This poses a challenge for academics who need to communicate complex ideas to both colleagues and non-experts. The study highlights the varying demands placed on writers depending on the context, purpose, and prior knowledge of their readers. For instance, an academic abstract requires concise and technical language, whereas a blog post may call for more engaging and accessible writing. Meanwhile, a public outreach article needs to convey complex information in a clear and simple manner. To address this challenge, researchers at Chalmers have been exploring the benefits of teaching doctoral students how to write across different genres simultaneously. By doing so, they aim to develop the "rhetorical agility needed to adapt writing styles to new contexts. According to Peter Wingrove, postdoctoral researcher and lead author of the study, this approach can help students navigate unfamiliar text types more effectively. The goal is not to teach every possible writing task that a doctoral student will encounter, but rather to equip them with the skills to approach different text types with confidence. By working with multiple genres at once, researchers believe that students can develop a deeper understanding of how to communicate complex ideas in various contexts. The workshop involved eight doctoral students who were tasked with working with three distinct text genres during a single session. The first task required them to analyze an academic abstract, identifying its intended audience, purpose, and structure. This exercise was meant to help participants understand the underlying principles of this genre. Next, the students worked in groups to transform a research blog post into an academic abstract, exploring various ways to present the content. They were given examples for reference but no explicit guidance on how to complete the task. This process allowed them to experiment with different approaches and see what worked best. The final assignment involved writing an abstract of their own research and then reworking it into a short popular science article. This exercise forced participants to adapt their writing style to reach a new audience, one that might not be familiar with technical jargon or academic terminology. They were encouraged to think creatively about how to engage this readership. The researchers analyzed the texts produced by the students, taking note of language and structural changes made in each genre. Some participants placed key findings early in their writing, while others employed storytelling techniques or used questions to capture the reader's attention. The use of technical terms was also adapted to suit the new audience. In analyzing the group discussions and interviews with the participants, the researchers found that these individuals were able to reason about their choices and identify areas where they needed to draw on existing knowledge or learn more. This ability to transfer skills between genres and adapt writing styles to different audiences is a key goal of Multi-Genre Pedagogy, an approach aimed at developing flexible writing skills and awareness of various text types. The process of making complex research accessible to a broader audience requires more than just explaining technical terms and concepts. It involves developing ideas in greater detail and acknowledging that specialists may take certain aspects for granted. According to Raffaella Negretti, professor at Chalmers University of Technology, understanding what readers need to follow the discussion is crucial. To achieve this goal, the concept of Multi-Genre Pedagogy" has been developed, aiming to equip doctoral students with flexible writing skills and awareness of various text genres. This approach enables students to adapt their writing styles to reach different audiences, a skill that can be applied across multiple disciplines. By doing so, researchers can communicate their findings more effectively, bridging the gap between academia and the general public. Ultimately, this ability to transfer skills between genres and adapt writing styles is essential for making research accessible and relevant to various stakeholders. articles.title: System Bottleneck Calculators Identify Performance Limitations
articles.summary: These tools help identify which component is limiting system performance during stress tests.
articles.content: Building and upgrading computer systems can be a daunting task, especially when it comes to ensuring that all components are compatible and working in harmony. To mitigate this complexity, bottleneck calculators have emerged as a valuable tool for system builders and upgraders alike. These tools help identify which component is limiting the rest of the system during stress tests, allowing users to pinpoint the issue and decide on the next course of action. A bottleneck occurs when one component holds back the others, hindering overall performance until the issue is resolved. For instance, if a CPU is maxing out its capacity while the GPU remains underutilized, it's likely experiencing a CPU bottleneck that's stifling the GPU's potential. Knowing which component is causing the bottleneck is crucial for deciding what to upgrade or troubleshoot next. When dealing with system bottlenecks, a common challenge is identifying which component is causing the issue. This is where online tools come in handy, offering a quick way to assess compatibility without having to stress-test your entire system. A bottleneck calculator works by comparing the performance of your chosen CPU and GPU at a specific resolution. Common benchmarks include 1080p, 1440p, and 2160p. The tool will then provide a score indicating how well each component handles the workload. If both components are capable of performing adequately at the target benchmark, you can expect a low bottleneck score, typically around ten percent or less. However, if one component is struggling to keep up, it will receive a higher percentage, signaling that it's the main culprit behind the bottleneck. In most cases, the CPU is the root cause of system bottlenecks. As the central processing unit, its primary function is to transmit information efficiently throughout the system. When it fails to do so, other components must wait for its signal, leading to stuttering in video games and other applications. A GPU bottleneck, on the other hand, typically occurs when the graphics card is overwhelmed by rendering high-resolution graphics or frame rates beyond its capabilities. This can result in screen tearing, low frame rates, and inconsistent system performance. The performance of a graphics processing unit (GPU) is heavily dependent on the number of pixels it renders per second, which explains why bottleneck calculators ask for your target resolution. However, this reliance on theoretical data from manufacturer spec sheets makes bottleneck calculators inherently unreliable. They fail to account for variability in other system components and the specific applications being tested, leading to inaccurate results. The limitations of bottleneck calculators become apparent when considering the differences between various graphics cards and their performance in different scenarios. For instance, a newer Intel GPU may struggle with older DirectX 11 applications that are easily handled by Nvidia or AMD cards. Bottleneck calculators are not designed for detailed system troubleshooting but can still be useful during system build planning. They provide a quick way to check if your chosen CPU and GPU combination can handle the desired resolution out of the box. Despite their limitations, bottleneck calculators can also serve as a fun tool for hobbyists to explore unusual hardware combinations that might not be commonly used or seen in practice. While bottleneck calculators may provide a basic understanding of how your GPU and CPU interact, they are not a foolproof method for assessing PC performance. These tools often rely on simplified calculations that can't account for various factors such as outdated drivers or background applications. A simple bottleneck percentage doesn't give the complete picture, as it fails to consider multiple variables including installed drivers and running apps that should be disabled during benchmarking. articles.content: Steam users may think they're familiar with the platform's overlay feature, but a closer look reveals a wealth of capabilities beyond what meets the eye. A significant update to Steam in 2023 introduced a revamped overlay that has set a new standard for game overlays and launchers across the industry. This redesigned interface offers an impressive array of features that enhance the gaming experience. For gamers who frequently use the overlay or are looking to explore its full potential, it's surprising how much functionality is available. To access Steam's overlay while playing games, press Shift + Tab on your keyboard simultaneously. If you're new to the platform, this shortcut will open up a world of possibilities. Alternatively, you can customize the key combination from within Steam's settings menu by clicking on the 'Settings' option and navigating to the 'In-Game' section. Steam users can adjust various overlay settings, including the ability to disable it altogether if needed. The platform is also smart enough to remember individual game configurations, so gamers don't have to reorganize the interface for each new title they play. The variety of features available through Steam's overlay has set a high bar for other platforms and publishers, who are now scrambling to catch up with the industry leader. As gamers continue to explore the capabilities of Steam's redesigned overlay, it will be interesting to see how its functionality evolves in response to user feedback and emerging trends in gaming technology. The Steam overlay has become a vital part of gaming on the platform, offering a wide range of features that can enhance your overall experience. One of the most useful features is the built-in browser, which allows you to access web pages without leaving your game. This is particularly handy for checking out online guides or tutorials that might help you overcome obstacles in your current playthrough. You can easily switch between your game and the browser by pressing a shortcut at the bottom of the overlay. The Steam overlay also offers a text editor, which can be useful when playing puzzle games like Blue Prince or Tunic. This feature allows you to jot down notes as you try to piece together clues, making it easier to keep track of your progress. The editor is fairly robust, allowing you to format text and even write code blocks. The overlay's features are not just limited to in-game tools. It also includes a timer function that can help you keep track of time while gaming. This is particularly useful for those who have limited gaming sessions due to other commitments. With the built-in timer, you can set reminders to switch between games or activities. Gamers with favorite community guides will appreciate being able to access them directly from the overlay. These guides are often excellent resources that offer valuable tips and strategies for completing levels or achieving specific goals in a game. The Steam overlay offers a range of features that go beyond just providing information about the game you're playing. For instance, you can view and manage screenshots and recordings directly from within the overlay. From here, you can browse through all your captured images and videos, even those taken in other games. When you click on one, you'll have the option to save it to a folder on your computer or share it with friends over Steam chat. Sharing your gaming experiences has never been easier. With just a few clicks, you can send your screenshots and recordings directly to social media platforms or even transfer them to your smartphone via the Steam Mobile app. The overlay's sharing capabilities extend to other features as well. You can also use it to manage your saved games, view game guides, and access other in-game resources. The Steam overlay offers more than just game management features, as it also enables seamless co-operative gameplay with friends through Valve's Remote Play Together protocol. This allows up to four players to join in on local co-op games over the internet, without requiring friends to own a copy of the game themselves, provided it supports the protocol. To start a co-op session, simply navigate to the Steam overlay and click the Remote Play button. From there, you can invite your friends to join in, giving them access to control the game alongside you - even if they don't have their own controller. articles.title: Armenia Arrests Opposition Figure Over Facebook Posts Criticizing PM Pashinyan
articles.summary: Adekvad party leader Artur Danielyan was arrested for criticizing Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan on Facebook, with charges stemming from his online activity.
articles.content: Armenia has seen a surge in arrests of opposition figures over the past two years, with many charges stemming from their online activity. The latest incident involves Artur Danielyan, leader of the opposition party Adekvad, who was arrested after criticizing Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan on Facebook. The grounds for Danielyan's detention were his Facebook posts, which targeted both Pashinyan and Armenia's security services. A key point of contention was Pashinyan's stance on a possible prisoner exchange with Azerbaijan, where an Azerbaijani soldier is accused of breaking into the home of a 39-year-old woman in an Armenian village. Pashinyan had ruled out swapping the soldier for detained Armenians in Azerbaijan in an interview with Infocom. Danielyan responded to this decision with a scathing attack on Pashinyan, calling him a "scumbag" and accusing him of being unwilling to bring his fellow citizens home. The conflict between Armenia and Azerbaijan over Nagorno-Karabakh has left a lasting impact on the region. After Azerbaijan's military offensive in 2023, Baku regained control over the territory, forcing over 100,000 Armenians to flee their homes. Currently, there are 19 Armenian individuals being held in detention in Baku. Armenia's civil society representatives have expressed concern that this wave of arrests signals a worrying turn toward democratic backsliding. They argue that selective justice undermines trust in the rule of law and may have far-reaching consequences for Armenia's relations with the European Union. Armenian civil society organizations have come out in force against what they see as selective prosecution of critics of the government. The joint statement from over a dozen organizations describes the charges brought against Adekvad party leader as "patently illegal, disproportionate, and politically motivated. Critics argue that these actions are not just punitive but also serve to silence dissenting voices and stifle public debate. Several other activists have faced prosecution for speaking out against the ruling establishment or Prime Minister Pashinyan. The case of Artur Osipyan is a notable example: he was arrested after a verbal clash with Pashinyan over Nagorno-Karabakh policy, and later charged with disrupting public order and obstructing the ruling party's campaign. Osipyan was also accused of inciting violence against Pashinyan in a social media post from March. The Regional Center for Democracy and Security (RCDS) has been monitoring online hate speech targeting Nagorno-Karabakh refugees since 2026. Their reports reveal a disturbing trend of pro-government bloggers and influential social media users spreading hostile rhetoric towards displaced Karabakh Armenians, using derogatory terms to label them. Despite these findings, Armenian law enforcement agencies have largely failed to pursue criminal prosecutions against these activists, allowing the hate speech to continue unchecked. The EU's response to Armenia's efforts to strengthen ties with the bloc has been lukewarm, with Brussels giving no clear indication of its stance on the silencing of opposition voices in Yerevan. According to observers, the EU is adopting a pragmatic approach driven by geopolitical considerations, prioritizing regional developments over human rights concerns. The Armenian government has been accused of selectively prosecuting critics of Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan, with some observers suggesting that this tactic is being used to label internal opponents as Russian proxies. A closer examination of the situation reveals that not everyone who criticizes Pashinyan holds pro-Russian views, and this nuance seems to be lost in the current geopolitical landscape. The EU's acceptance of the right narrative" surrounding these criticisms has raised concerns about its commitment to democratic values. The EU-Armenia Comprehensive and Enhanced Partnership Agreement emphasizes the importance of democracy, the rule of law, and fundamental rights in their partnership. In response to questions from DW, an EU spokesperson stressed that it is closely monitoring developments in Armenia, including criminal investigations, which must be conducted independently and impartially, free from political influence. articles.content: A mother of three has abandoned her smart TV in favor of an old VHS player, citing improved behavior from her children as a result. This excessive screen time had become unsustainable, but the mother felt overwhelmed by the task of finding a solution. The turning point arrived when she discovered that the smart TV's menu system would automatically display unwanted advertisements for movies and shows. The introduction of these ads inadvertently led one of the children to watch a trailer for a horror film, causing her significant distress. To mitigate this issue, the mother hid the remote control and told her kids it was broken until she could come up with an alternative plan. This drastic measure may have been extreme but ultimately allowed her family to reassess their relationship with screens. The initial days without TV were difficult, with the children constantly asking to watch something. However, their behavior quickly adapted to the change, and within a week they were rarely requesting screen time. The mother's decision has sparked curiosity about whether abandoning modern entertainment technology can have a positive impact on family dynamics. The family's experiment with vintage technology continued to yield surprising benefits as they delved deeper into the world of retro entertainment. To further reduce their reliance on modern gadgets, a boombox and CDs were introduced, allowing them to listen to music together. In addition to music, classic video games also made an appearance in the form of Game Boys, which proved to be just as engaging for the children as they had been when their parents were kids. The novelty of old technology was still evident despite its age, with the kids showing a strong enthusiasm for these retro devices. The family's collection of VHS tapes, inherited from the mother's own childhood, provided a treasure trove of classic films to enjoy together. These old movies sparked a new interest in the children and proved to be an effective way to spend quality time as a family without relying on modern screens. The shift towards vintage entertainment has also had a positive impact on the household's atmosphere, with the mother noting that her children now watch less TV, fight less frequently, and exhibit fewer tantrums than they did before. The shift towards vintage entertainment has had a profound impact on the household's atmosphere, allowing parents to exert greater control over what their children watch. This change in viewing habits has been particularly beneficial for safety, as parents can now more easily monitor and regulate the content their children consume. One notable improvement is the reduction in arguments between siblings. The absence of constant TV exposure seems to have had a calming effect on the household, with children exhibiting fewer signs of agitation than before. The introduction of vintage entertainment has also encouraged creativity among older children. articles.title: Ancient Maya's Use of Red Paint Linked to Mercury Poisoning
articles.summary: A new study reveals that the ancient Maya civilization's extensive use of cinnabar in their red paint led to mercury poisoning in lakes and waterways.
articles.content: The use of red paint by the ancient Maya civilization has been linked to environmental disaster. A new study reveals that the Maya's extensive use of cinnabar, a vibrant red pigment made from mercury-sulfide mineral, led to the poisoning of their lakes and waterways with mercury. Cinnabar was a common ingredient in the paint used by the Maya, who were known for their love of the color red. They applied it to almost everything, including sculptures, monuments, walls, plazas, pottery, and even the dead as part of ceremonial funerals. This widespread use of cinnabar led to the contamination of nearby waterways. When the paint ran off into lakes and rivers, anaerobic bacteria in the sediments transformed the cinnabar into highly toxic methylmercury. Over time, this substance accumulated in the food chain, posing a significant threat to the environment. The Maya's use of red paint is an example of how human activities can have unintended consequences on the environment. Their passion for the color red, which represented the sun, blood, and life, ultimately led to environmental disaster. The Maya's reliance on freshwater resources was a crucial aspect of their daily lives, and they heavily depended on fisheries for protein, including freshwater shellfish. Previous research had already indicated high levels of mercury in certain regions of the Maya's territory, but its presence in Mexico's Yucatán Peninsula remained unexamined until now. Researchers decided to investigate this area, specifically looking at mud sediments from the region for signs of mercury poisoning. The study focused on two sites: Cobá Lake and Cenote Xcach, a flooded sinkhole beside a ruined city. At these locations, sediment cores were analyzed for mercury levels, revealing extreme concentrations that hinted at widespread use of cinnabar paint, a likely source of the toxic mineral. The amounts of mercury detected in the sediment cores were staggering, with some samples containing as much as 820 parts per billion. For context, authorities consider water with mercury levels above 2 parts per billion to be unsafe for consumption, while any fish exceeding 1 part per million can be seized. These findings suggest that the Maya's use of cinnabar paint was far more extensive than previously thought, and it is likely that this excessive use contributed to environmental disasters in their region. The presence of mercury in the waterways around the ancient Maya civilization's cities has been confirmed through an analysis of sediment cores. Researchers have found that these sediment cores contain high levels of mercury, a toxic substance that can cause severe poisoning when ingested or absorbed through the skin. In humans, mercury poisoning can lead to permanent damage to internal organs and brain function, as well as death. The team discovered mercury levels in excess of 3 parts per million in some areas, which is far higher than the threshold at which poisoning becomes a significant health risk. This excessive exposure to mercury would have had devastating consequences for the people living in these regions. The presence of mercury in the water at Cenote Xcach suggests a long-standing problem that may have contributed to the collapse of the Maya civilization. The sediment cores revealed that mercury levels were high during the Preclassic and Classic periods, but by the time of the collapse, these levels had begun to decrease in many areas. The cinnabar used to create the vibrant red paint must have been imported from outside the Yucatán region, likely from what is now Honduras. This importation continued until the collapse, as evidenced by the mercury poisoning that persisted at Cenote Xcach during this time.
